title: My Weekend
text:
On Saturdays, I like to relax. In the morning, I ride my bike in the park. In the afternoon, I play football with my friends.

On Sunday, my family goes to the cinema. We watch a funny film together. After that, we eat ice cream in a small café.

questions.text: What does the writer do in the park?
Where does the family go on Sunday?
How does the writer probably feel about weekends?
Why does the family probably feel happy after the film?

vocabulary.definition: a place where you go to watch films
a small place where you can buy drinks and snacks

paragraph_translations: W soboty lubię odpoczywać. Rano jeżdżę na rowerze w parku. Po południu gram w piłkę nożną z przyjaciółmi.
W niedzielę moja rodzina idzie do kina. Razem oglądamy zabawny film. Potem jemy lody w małej kawiarni.
